name: Antang de Xinli Zixun Shi: Bei Zhong Zhi Xin
original_name: 安堂的心理咨询室：杯中之心
source:
Life’s lowest points always come unexpectedly. The first time you encounter them, there’s always a thought: “I want to run away.” Among these moments, there are always unfortunate people who break away from their groups, shake off the helping hands reaching out to them, and become “escapers.”

Pulse of Cup is a story about such people.

Set in the urban jungle of Japan, this is a tale where the machinery of counseling meets those lost “escapers.” During the harsh winter, warm drinks are offered, and as the counselor, you will help untangle the knots in the hearts of these “escapers” through thoughtful choices. Guide them, through your decisions, toward a brighter path.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1416160/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
人生的最低谷总是在不经意间到来。第一次遇到他们的时候，总会有一个念头：“我想逃跑。”在这些时刻，总有一些不幸的人脱离了群体，摆脱了向他们伸出的援助之手，成为“逃亡者”。

《杯子的脉动》就是关于这样的人的故事。

这个故事以日本的城市丛林为背景，讲述了咨询机制与迷失的“逃亡者”相遇的故事。严冬期间，提供热饮，而作为辅导员的你，将通过深思熟虑的选择，帮助这些“逃亡者”解开心中的疙瘩。通过你的决定引导他们走向更光明的道路。

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1416160/]Steam[/url]]
